SUBJECT: manuscript by V.D. Jiganoff entitled "About myself" - Antecedents of author and comment on contents.

Vladimir Danilovich JIGANOFF, the author of the manuscript in question, was born on 1-11-1896 in the Maritime Province, Russia. According to his own statement, he saw active service in the ranks of the Imperial Russian Army in 1914-1917 and in Admiral Kelchak's White Army in Siberia from 1918 to the end of 1919, having attained during the latter period the rank of Captain. At the time of the evacuation of the Maritime Province by the Whites in October, 1922 he was working with fisheries in Kamchatka where he subsequently remained following the establishment of the Soviet regime there. Being arrested by the bolsheviks in the autumn of 1925 he was placed aboard the s.s. "Indigirka" bound for Vladivostok, but succeeded to escape from custody during the vessel's stay in the port of Hakodate, wherefrom he subsequently made his way to Shanghai, arriving in this city on 25-12-25. Here he worked as a watchman for about three years, after which he was connected with the "Russian Society of Medical Aid" - an organization which was formed on his initiative in 1928 and proved to be a failure after some three years of existence. For the following eight years or so he was mainly engaged in the work of compiling, editing, publishing and selling an illustrated album entitled "Russians in Shanghai" - a work of which he is ,perhaps justly, proud.

In 1939 he published a booklet containing his impressions while visiting Japan , in which he highly praised that country ( the visit in question refers to some time in 1938-1939 ). In the spring of 1940 he ferm-

主题：V.D. 日加诺夫题为《关于我自己》的手稿——作者背景及内容评论。

该手稿作者弗拉基米尔·达尼洛维奇·日加诺夫（Vladimir Danilovich JIGANOFF），于1896年11月1日出生于俄罗斯滨海边疆区。据其自称，他于1914年至1917年间在沙皇俄国军队中服现役，并于1918年至1919年底在西伯利亚的科尔恰克海军上将（Admiral Kolchak）白军中服役，在此期间晋升为上尉军衔。1922年10月白军撤离滨海边疆区时，他在堪察加从事渔业工作，并在该地区建立苏维埃政权后继续留居当地。1925年秋被布尔什维克逮捕后，他被送上驶往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的“因迪吉尔卡”号（s.s. "Indigirka"）轮船，但在该船停靠函馆港期间成功逃脱监管，随后前往上海，于1925年12月25日抵达本市。在此后的约三年时间里，他担任看守员，之后参与了“俄罗斯医疗援助协会”的工作——该组织由他于1928年发起成立，但在存在约三年后证明以失败告终。在随后的八年左右时间里，他主要从事编纂、编辑、出版和销售名为《在上海的俄罗斯人》的图解相册的工作——对于这部作品，他或许当之无愧地感到自豪。

1939年，他出版了一本小册子，收录了他访问日本时的印象，其中对该国大加赞赏（此次访问指的是1938-1939年间的某个时间）。1940年春，他组

In his latest registration form at the Russian Emi-

Following the outbreak of the present Soviet-German war
Jiganoff thought it necessary to publish,in August,1941, a
pamphlet entitled " In defence of Motherland" in which,stres-
sing his anti-communist attitude, he denounced the defeatist
tendencies existing in certain circles of the local Russian
emigrant community,who,he maintained, followed the shameful
example set up by Lenin during the war 1914-1918 in order to
seize power in Russia. The pamphlet,rather hysterical in its
general tone,was not free from "mud-slinging" at those who
did not happen to see eye to eye with Jiganoff in this matter.
Later he published a few articles of the same nature in local
Russian press. For this attitude and his noisy declarations
of patriotism he was sharply rebuked in some emigrant papers,
but was mentioned as a "true patriot" by the pro-Soviet "No-
vosti Dnia".

In the manuscript now submitted by Jiganoff for cen-
sorship,the same denouncing of "defeatism" amongst local Rus-
sian emigrants forms the only point of interest . The present
rulers of the USSR also come under criticism for obstructing
national Russian elements in the task of defence of their Mo-
therland. The rest of the manuscript is devoted to personal
affairs,self-praise and voicing his grievances against the lo-

在他最近在俄罗斯侨民委员会填写的登记表上，他声称自己“过去是、现在是、将来也永远是反共主义者”，而直到最近为止，关于他及其活动的已知情况似乎都证实了他的反共立场。

随着当前苏德战争的爆发，日加诺夫认为有必要于1941年8月出版一本名为《保卫祖国》的小册子，其中在强调其反共立场的同时，谴责了当地俄罗斯侨民社区某些圈子中存在的失败主义倾向，他声称这些人效仿列宁在1914-1918年战争期间为夺取俄国政权所树立的可耻榜样。这本小册子总体基调相当歇斯底里，不乏对那些在此事上与日加诺夫意见不合者的“泼脏水”行为。后来，他在当地俄文报刊上发表了几篇性质相同的文章。由于这种态度和他大声疾呼的爱国宣言，他在一些侨民报纸上受到严厉斥责，但被亲苏的《每日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）称为“真正的爱国者”。

在日加诺夫现在提交审查的手稿中，同样谴责当地俄罗斯侨民中的“失败主义”构成了唯一的关注点。苏联目前的统治者也因阻碍俄罗斯民族元素履行保卫祖国的任务而受到批评。手稿的其余部分致力于个人事务、自我吹嘘，以及表达对当

Manuscript by V.D. Jiganoff entitled "About
myself" - Antecedents of author and comment
on contents.

Vladimir Danilovich JIGANOFF,the author of the
manuscript in question,was born on 1-11-1896 in the Mari-
time Province,Russia. According to his own statement, he
saw active service in the ranks of the Imperial Russian
Army in 1914-1917 and in Admiral Kolchak's White Army in
Siberia from 1918 to the end of 1919, having attained du-
ring the latter period the rank of Captain. At the time
of the evacuation of the Maritime Province by the Whites
in October,1922 he was working with fisheries in Kamchat-
ka where he subsequently remained following the establish-
ment of the Soviet regime there. Being arrested by the bol-
sheviks in the autumn of 1925 he was placed aboard the
s.s."Indigirka" bound for Vladivostok,but succeeded to es-
cape from custody during the vessel's stay in the port of
Hakodate,wherefrom he subsequently made his way to Shang-
hai,arriving in this city on 25-12-25. Here he worked as
a watchman for about three years,after which he was con-
nected with the "Russian Society of Medical Aid" - an or-
ganization which was formed on his initiative in 1928 and
proved to be a failure after some three years of existence;
for the following eight years or so he was mainly engaged
in the work of compiling,editing,publishing and selling
an illustrated album entitled "Russians in Shanghai" - a
work of which he is ,perhaps justly,proud.

In 1939 he published a booklet containing his
impressions while visiting Japan , in which he highly
praised that country ( the visit in question refers to
some time in 1938-1939 ). In the spring of 1940 he form-

该手稿作者弗拉基米尔·达尼洛维奇·日加诺夫（Vladimir Danilovich JIGANOFF），于1896年11月1日出生于俄罗斯滨海边疆区。据其自称，他于1914年至1917年间在沙皇俄国军队中服现役，并于1918年至1919年底在西伯利亚的科尔恰克海军上将（Admiral Kolchak）白军中服役，在此期间晋升为上尉军衔。1922年10月白军撤离滨海边疆区时，他在堪察加从事渔业工作，并在该地区建立苏维埃政权后继续留居当地。1925年秋被布尔什维克逮捕后，他被送上驶往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的“因迪吉尔卡”号（s.s. "Indigirka"）轮船，但在该船停靠函馆港期间成功逃脱监管，随后前往上海，于1925年12月25日抵达本市。在此后的约三年时间里，他担任看守员，之后参与了“俄罗斯医疗援助协会”的工作——该组织由他于1928年发起成立，但在存在约三年后证明以失败告终；在随后的八年左右时间里，他主要从事编纂、编辑、出版和销售名为《在上海的俄罗斯人》的图解相册的工作——对于这部作品，他或许当之无愧地感到自豪。

1939年，他出版了一本小册子，收录了他访问日本时的印象，其中对该国大加赞赏（此次访问指的是1938-1939年间的某个时间）。1940年春，他组

In his latest registration form at the Russian Emi-

Following the outbreak of the present Soviet-German war
Jiganoff thought it necessary to publish,in August,1941, a
pamphlet entitled " In defence of Motherland" in which,stres-
sing his anti-communist attitude, he denounced the defeatist
tendencies existing in certain circles of the local Russian
emigrant community,who,he maintained, followed the shameful
example set up by Lenin during the war 1914-1918 in order to

general tone,was not free from "mud-slinging" at those who
did not happen to see eye to eye with Jiganoff in this matter.
Later he published a few articles of the same nature in local
Russian press. For this attitude and his noisy declarations
of patriotism he was sharply rebuked in some emigrant papers,
but was mentioned as a "true patriot" by the pro-Soviet "No-
vosti Dnia".
In the manuscript now submitted by Jiganoff for cen-
sorship,the same denouncing of "defeatism" amongst local Rus-
sian emigrants forms the only point of interest . The present
rulers of the USSR also come under criticism for obstructing
national Russian elements in the task of defence of their Mo-
therland. The rest of the manuscript is devoted to personal
affairs,self-praise and voicing his grievances against the le-

Vladimir Danilovich JIGANOFF, Russian, born
1-11-1896 in the Maritime Province, Russia.
An ex-officer of the "White" Russian Army in
Siberia, he is reported to have escaped from
the USSR to Japan some time in 1925 and ar-
rived in Shanghai later during the same year.

Here he was employed as a watchman with vario
ous local firms for several years, after which
he was connected with the "Russian Society of
Medical Aid" from 1928 to 1930. For the past s
several years he has been without fixed employ
ment, being mainly engaged in the publishing
of an illustrated album entitled "Russians in
Shanghai". About two years ago he made a trip
to Japan and upon return published a booklet
recording his impressions.
Another booklet entitled "In defence of Mother
land" was published by him soon after the out-
break of the present Soviet-German war in con
nection with the Declaration of Russian "defea
tist organizations".
Upon return to Shanghai founded in April, 1940
a "Society for promotion of Study of Nipponese
Language" - a purely fictitious institution.

Articles in the "VOSKHOD"

19-8-41: Russians wishing to join the Allied
Forces. - applied.

Nothing in Municipal Police records to
indicate that he has a criminal record.

弗拉基米尔·达尼洛维奇·日加诺夫（Vladimir Danilovich JIGANOFF），俄罗斯人，1896年11月1日出生于俄罗斯滨海边疆区。
据报，他曾是西伯利亚“白”俄军队的一名军官，于1925年某时从苏联逃往日本，并于同年晚些时候抵达上海。

在此后的数年里，他受雇于当地多家商行担任看守，随后于1928年至1930年间与“俄罗斯医疗援助协会”有关联。在过去几年中，他没有固定职业，主要从事出版一本名为《在上海的俄罗斯人》的图解相册的工作。大约两年前，他曾前往日本旅行，回国后出版了一本记录其见闻的小册子。
在当前苏德战争爆发后不久，他又出版了另一本名为《保卫祖国》的小册子，这与俄罗斯“失败主义组织”的宣言有关。
返回上海后，他于1940年4月创立了一个“日语学习促进会”——这纯粹是一个虚构的机构。

《沃斯科霍德》（VOSKHOD）报上的文章

1941年8月19日：希望加入盟军的俄罗斯人。——已申请。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何记录表明他有犯罪前科。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Censorship Section
Intelligence Dept.
REPORT
Station........................................ File No.................... Date 16-2-1944
SUBJECT: Re Intended Publication Of A Booklet
Entitled "About Myself".

With reference to the attached letter, Mr. V.
Jiganoff, Russian emigrant residing at 318 Route
Frelupt, at present unemployed, came to this office
and requested the permission of publishing a booklet
entitled "About Myself", his autobiography. The
booklet is intended to be published in 250 copies and
will be printed at 335 Rue Cardinal Mercier, "Russian
Invalid Press".

It will contain 164 pages and will be sold for
$40.00 a copy. The publication will be covered through
the sale of the booklet.

The attached proof of the proposed booklet were
scrutinised by the undersigned. The author writes
his biography, mentioning his merits to the Russian
community in Shanghai by organizing "Russian Mutual
Medical Assistance Society" and by publishing an album
entitled "Russians In Shanghai" in which he gives the
history of Russian community in Shanghai. The public,
however, says the author, did not appreciate his good
deeds. Some of them called him a communist, the other
a "White Bandit" (a white Russian who fought with
Bolsheviks during civil war in Russia)

The author tries to explain that he is a real
patriot, who loves his country and his people.
Although he strongly criticizes the communistic regime
in Russia, he praises the Soviet army, which consists
of Russian people, who are fighting at present not
for the sake of Internationalism (Communism) but for
their fatherland, he concludes. Nothing to the
detriment of Mr. Jiganoff is known to this office.
K. S. Alperin
P.S.I.
（印：批莉）
（印：陸錫蕃）

警署........................................ 档案号.................... 日期 1944年2月16日
事由：关于拟出版一本名为《关于我自己》的小册子事宜。

参照附件信函，俄罗斯侨民 V. 日加诺夫先生，现居弗雷吕普路（Route Frelupt）318号，目前失业，来到本办公室，请求批准出版一本名为《关于我自己》的自传体小册子。该小册子计划印制250册，将在卡迪纳尔·梅尔西埃路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）335号的“俄罗斯伤残军人印刷所”印刷。

该书将包含164页，每册售价40.00元。出版费用将通过销售该小册子来覆盖。

签署人仔细审阅了所附的拟出版小册子的校样。作者在书中撰写了自己的生平，提及他对上海俄罗斯社区的贡献，包括组织“俄罗斯互助医疗协会”以及出版一本名为《在上海的俄罗斯人》的相册，其中记载了上海俄罗斯社区的历史。然而，作者称公众并未赏识他的善行。有些人称他为共产主义者，另一些人则称他为“白匪”（指在俄国内战期间与布尔什维克作战的白俄人）。

作者试图解释他是一位真正的爱国者，热爱自己的国家和人民。尽管他强烈批评俄罗斯的共产主义政权，但他赞扬苏联军队，认为这支由俄罗斯人民组成的军队，目前作战并非为了国际主义（共产主义），而是为了他们的祖国，他总结道。本办公室未掌握任何对日加诺夫先生不利的信息。
K. S. 阿尔佩林（Alperin）
警务副督察
（印：批莉）
（印：陸錫蕃）

To the cheif of Shanghai Censorship.

I have the honour of informing
you that I am Mr. V. Jiganoff
living at 318 route Freduft.

During 1927 I worked in Russian detachment
of S.V.C.
1928-1931 I was a president of the Russian
Mutual Medical Assistance Society.
From 1931-1940 was a publisher of
the Russian Grand Almanach.
Since last year was a teacher
of Japanese language.

The most of my life I lived
not for myself but for my Country and
for my people. I have them my
best years and the maximum of
my energy. But neither my Country
nore my people, who are present
in Shanghai, for whom I lived, did
not understand me.
pages.zh:
致上海审查处处长。

我荣幸地告知您，我是 V. 日加诺夫先生，
居住在弗雷杜夫特路（route Freduft）318号。

1927年期间，我在上海志愿队（S.V.C.）的俄罗斯分队工作。
1928-1931年，我担任俄罗斯互助医疗协会会长。
1931-1940年，我是《俄罗斯大 Almanach》的出版人。
自去年起，我担任日语教师。

我的一生大部分时间不是为自己而活，而是为我的国家和人民而活。我将我最美好的年华和最大的精力都奉献给了他们。但是，无论是我的国家，还是目前在上海、我曾为之效力的同胞，都不理解我。
